english.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for a disorderly mess or a bad situation.
This is the all-purpose everyday choice for a situation, room, or life that is a complete mess.
This is the all-purpose choice for a general messy or confused situation.
Use this when stressing that a situation or place is a complete mess.
Use this when circus means a chaotic or disorderly place.
